capabilities: add categories and tags to posts
browse posts on the Typecho site
configure host, token, and user credentials
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese) but short; it lists features and configuration fields without usage examples or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push notes as posts to a Typecho site.
summary: Publishing plugin that synchronizes Obsidian files to a Typecho blog, including categories and tags.
